slot.brief: A network of identical resistors forming a balanced Wheatstone bridge; simplify by symmetry, find equivalent resistance and current through the galvanometer arm (zero in balanced case).

stem: Four identical $6\ \text{Ω}$ resistors form the arms of a Wheatstone bridge, with a $3\ \text{Ω}$ galvanometer across the middle. A $12$ V source is connected across opposite vertices of the bridge. Find the equivalent resistance and galvanometer current.

verdicts.working: The bridge is balanced by symmetry, so the galvanometer current is 0 A. Each side path has 6 + 6 = 12 Ω; the two paths are in parallel, giving 6 Ω.

working:
Balanced bridge: $I_G=0$
$R_{\text{eq}}=(6+6)\parallel(6+6)=12\parallel12=6\ \text{Ω}$

Independent check: The bridge is balanced by symmetry, so the galvanometer current is 0 A. Each side path has 6 + 6 = 12 Ω; the two paths are in parallel, giving 6 Ω.
solution:
By symmetry, the Wheatstone bridge is balanced, so $I_G=0$. Each branch has resistance $6+6=12\,\Omega$, and the two branches are in parallel:
$$R_{\text{eq}}=12\parallel12=6\,\Omega.$$
Thus, $R_{\text{eq}}=6\,\Omega$ and $I_G=0\,\text{A}$.
